description: The row names a rule the case does not declare. `lesson-50` is why the rule is in the fixture at all: a point carries several, and a case that fires on a neighbouring one looks like proof while proving something else.

# Negative control of the alpha gate

Deliberately defective inputs. `tools/check-alpha.mjs` runs all three of its points on each
of them and **requires every one to be rejected — and rejected by the point it declares**.

## The cases

| case            | point | check    | rule      | defect                  |
| --------------- | ----: | -------- | --------- | ----------------------- |
| `a-case`        |     1 | `first`  | `mended`  | the first thing breaks  |
| `another-case`  |     2 | `second` | —         | the second thing breaks |
| `a-third-case`  |     3 | `third`  | `unnamed` | the third thing breaks  |
